notes.title: P-BOT - Patch Notes! Version 1.1.2
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36467246/74426ff837e1c5caf6ff7b4699d77ed55efafa56.png
New Features
Delivery Mode Added an conveyor belt that boosts the player

Fly Mode Added firework cannons that shoot fireworks into the air

Climb Mode Added moving elevators
 Added industrial coolers
 Added conveyor belts that move the player

Changes
Delivery Mode Removed the wall jumps

notes.title: P-BOT - Patch Notes! Version 1.1.1
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36467246/8686ed2ee4a280b14752ad0827465717de1cbb10.png
New Features
Fly Mode Added obstacle lasers that move up and down

Climb Mode Added a piston obstacle that pushes the player of the building

Changes
Fly Mode Made the factory entrance and exit bigger

Climb Mode Changed the blockade visual to a window cleaning rig

Bug fixes
GeneralFixed a bug where the leaderboard images didn't load correctly

Climb ModeFixed a bug where the camera wouldn't rotate correctly

notes.title: P-BOT - Patch Notes! Version 1.1.0
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36467246/d69e2061b82f57f49dc419d9cff6b5286c97e724.png
New Features
Climb Mode The player can now rotate the camera whilst climbing
 Added obstacle planes that fly close to the building


Bug fixes
Fly ModeFixed a bug where the player could clip through the train station floor
